mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in economic supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% MoM, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of periods with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing by more than 2.5% YoY, it signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
